methodology.exact_files: SHA-256 of complete tracked file bytes; cross-add-on groups only.
methodology.exact_java_tokens: Comments/whitespace and package/import declarations are removed; identifiers and literals, including complete Java text blocks, are preserved.
methodology.github_actions_syntax: A fail-closed GitHub Actions YAML subset parser fingerprints jobs with workflow context and individual steps. Mapping order, triggers, permissions, action references, scalar values, and run-block content hashes are preserved; anchors and aliases are rejected.
methodology.gradle_syntax: A fail-closed balanced Groovy token pass recognizes slashy and triple-quoted literals, then fingerprints blocks, task declarations, and closures. Only def bindings and direct closure parameters may be normalized; coordinates, task names, properties, paths, URLs, and hashes remain exact.
methodology.interpretation_note: Renamed clones are candidates for review, not proof of equivalent behavior. Layer labels keep infrastructure/test repetition separate from behavior-heavy rendering code.
methodology.method_boundary_note: Method declarations are recognized with a deterministic lexical brace/parenthesis pass. Whole-file token fingerprints cover Java constructs the method pass does not recognize.
methodology.python_ast: The standard-library AST parser fingerprints functions, async functions, and classes. Local normalization renames only proven function arguments and bindings; literals, attributes, imports, keyword names, and declared API names remain exact.
methodology.renamed_java_tokens: Each identifier is alpha-renamed by first occurrence and literal values, including text blocks, are typed; groups must contain at least two exact-token fingerprints.
methodology.shell_syntax: Tracked Bash files and GitHub Actions Bash run blocks must pass bash -n. shlex fingerprints preserve command words, flags, variables, paths, URLs, hashes, and heredoc-body hashes; shell identifiers are not renamed.

benefits: Removes the largest byte-identical script/config copies without adding a server runtime dependency.
Makes gallery and release-policy fixes land once and gives all repositories the same deterministic checks.
coupling_and_abi_risks: A shared tool version must remain pinned so an old add-on can still reproduce its release.
Gallery generators have legitimate schema variants; keep extension hooks instead of forcing one data model.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Extract first as versioned CLI/Gradle conventions. Keep generated gallery data in each add-on.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Development and release toolkit

benefits: Centralizes exact-artifact gating, bounded diagnostics, and fail-closed activation behavior.
Reduces the chance that one add-on drifts from the portfolio's compatibility policy.
coupling_and_abi_risks: A shared runtime JAR creates ABI/version-skew and class-loader questions across independently released packs.
Artifact profiles contain add-on-specific pins and must remain declarative inputs, not shared mutable state.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Extract pure contracts and utilities after combined tests; retain each add-on's profile data locally.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Activation, artifact identity, and diagnostics runtime

benefits: Shares the four-consumer Athena face and connection vocabulary behind conformance fixtures.
Keeps exact resource interpretation in one source module without adding an installed dependency.
coupling_and_abi_risks: The two emitter variants have real culling and top-only differences that need a tested strategy.
Consumer allowlists, artifact profiles, and generated resource closures must remain local.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Extract after freezing the Chipped, Chisel, CobbleFurnies, and Factory Blocks fixtures.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Athena resource-model source module

benefits: Shares the proven four-consumer Fusion direction, orientation, texture, and emission contracts.
Creates one fixture-backed home for connected-face and UV correctness.
coupling_and_abi_risks: Format profiles and namespace routing differ and cannot be normalized mechanically.
BlueMap-derived emitter mechanics require their existing notice and provenance boundary.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Extract the exact common contract; keep format versions, catalogs, and route allowlists local.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Fusion resource-model source module

benefits: Shares proven lighting, immutable geometry records, and transforms without owning block routes.
Lets behavior-heavy add-ons focus on state and block-entity interpretation.
coupling_and_abi_risks: Similar helper names do not prove identical UV, lighting, coordinate, or material semantics.
BlueMap mesh emission must remain isolated in a version-specific adapter module.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Start only with exact multi-consumer APIs such as the seven-copy FaceLighting contract.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Neutral rendering primitives

benefits: Shares the three-Ars-consumer installed Geo hierarchy, UV, and mesh compilation contract.
Reduces repeated bounded parser and malformed-input behavior.
coupling_and_abi_risks: Wavefront, OBJ, Blockbench/BBS, and Gecko-style formats are not one generic compiler.
The three consumers need a common malformed-input and fallback fixture suite first.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Treat as provisional until Ars Nouveau, Ars Technica, and Ars Creo pass one parity suite.
reusable_module_candidates.title: Installed Geo resource-model source module

benefits: Consolidates adapter compatibility probes and resource-extension registration used throughout the portfolio.
Provides one migration seam for later BlueMap internal API changes.
coupling_and_abi_risks: The code is coupled to BlueMap internals and currently names the 5.22 adapter generation.
Extracting while the 5.23 backport is under integration could freeze the wrong ABI.
reusable_module_candidates.recommendation: Design now, but publish only after the 5.23 integration branch has a stable combined runtime gate.
reusable_module_candidates.title: BlueMap adapter bootstrap API
